# Boqin Yuan

> Machine learning engineer working across the LLM stack: AI agent development and evaluation,
> model training and alignment, and ML systems and inference optimization. MS Computer Science at
> UC San Diego. Previously a full-time ML engineer at CambioML (YC S23).
> Graduating December 2026. Available for full-time roles from January 2027.

Contact: b4yuan@ucsd.edu
Site: https://boqiny.github.io
GitHub: https://github.com/boqiny
LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/boqin-yuan
Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=AglrzBgAAAAJ

## Focus areas

- **Agent evaluation and benchmarks.** Co-author of SkillsBench and Agents' Last Exam, community
  benchmarks measuring how well LLM agents handle real, expertise-heavy work. Authored a merged
  adapter (PR #1635) in Harbor, the 3.7k-star agent-evaluation framework used by Terminal-Bench:
  https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/1635
- **Agent memory.** Co-author of AMA-Bench (ICML 2026), an evaluation framework for long-horizon
  memory in agentic applications. First author of memory-probe (ICLR 2026 workshop), which separates
  retrieval failures from utilization failures in agent memory.
- **Model training and alignment.** Trained and productionized AnyParser, a 1B/2B vision-language
  model for parsing PDFs into structured Markdown, using full fine-tuning plus preference alignment
  to beat GPT-4 baselines on parsing accuracy.
- **ML systems and inference.** Achieved 8x inference throughput on L4 GPUs with SGLang, deployed on
  AWS (ECS + Lambda), with per-user Kubernetes-isolated sandbox sessions serving over 1,000 users.

## Experience

- **Moody's Analytics** (Jun 2026 - Aug 2026, San Francisco): SDE Intern - AI Agent (internship).
  Work on agent evaluation and knowledge iteration for Moody's banking decision-intelligence agent:
  injecting domain knowledge through skills, then measuring and optimizing against Langfuse traces,
  inside a LangGraph orchestration on AWS.
- **CambioML (YC S23)** (Jul 2024 - Jul 2025, San Jose): Machine Learning Engineer, full-time.
  Built AnyParser (vision-language model, fine-tuning and preference alignment, SGLang serving) and
  led Energent.ai, a Claude-powered computer-use agent platform scaled past 1,000 users.
- **Inspur Group** (May 2023 - Aug 2023): ML Engineer Intern. YOLOv7 detection and pose estimation,
  TensorRT inference acceleration.
- **UC San Diego, STABLE Lab** (2025 - present): MS Computer Science, agent memory and ML systems
  research with Prof. Jishen Zhao.
- **UIUC, Supercomputing System and AI Lab (SSAIL)** (Oct 2024 - Mar 2025): Research Assistant with
  Prof. Minjia Zhang. Extended DeepSpeed-Chat, which shipped with PPO only, to preference-based
  post-training: a DPO trainer (reference-policy log-ratios, adaptive KL control) and a best-of-N
  rejection-sampling variant, on DeepSpeed's hybrid engine and ZeRO. Code: https://github.com/boqiny/deepspeed-chat
- **UIUC** (2020 - 2024): BS Mathematics & Computer Science, and Statistics. Research at NCSA and
  the Illinois Geometry Lab.
